signup.heroDesc: Pangani akaunti yanu, yankhani mafunso opempha a wokwera, ndipo ikani zikalata zonse za KYC kuphatikizapo malipiro atatu asanalowe pa nsanja.
signup.title: Pangani akaunti & kupempha
signup.subtitle: Palibe umboni wa adilesi ofunika. Ikani ID, layisensi, chithunzi, ndi malipiro atatu aposachedwa.
signup.step1Help: Gwiritsani ntchito dzina lanu lenileni, imelo yogwira ntchito, nambala ya WhatsApp, nambala yanu ya ID/pasipoti/kuthawira dziko, ndi mawu achinsinsi okhala ndi zilembo zosachepera 6.
signup.successToast: Akaunti yapangidwa ndipo pempho lonse latumizidwa. Tikuwunika zikalata zanu tsopano.
signup.modalDesc: Pempho lanu silingapitirire mpaka zambiri zofunika pansipa zikwaniritsidwe moyenera.

fleetApply.availableBikesDesc: Sankhani pa njinga zomwe zilipo zobwereka-mpaka-kukhala-mwini kudzera mwa {{fleetName}}. Sankhani njinga yomwe mumakonda pa nthawi ya kupempha.
fleetApply.clickToSelect: Dinani njinga kuti muisankhe msanga mu pempho lanu. Mutha kusintha zomwe mwasankha pa sitepe 3.
fleetApply.title: Tumizani pempho la wokwera
fleetApply.bikeAvailabilityDesc: Njinga zomwe zilipo kwa mwini gulu ili zokha ndizo zikuwonekera pano.
fleetApply.step4Help: Ikani chikalata cha ID, layisensi yoyendetsa, chithunzi, ndi malipiro anu atatu aposachedwa. Malipiro atha kukhala PDF, chithunzi, chikalata cha Word, kapena mtundu wina uliwonse wamba — ngati sichili PDF, mudzafunsidwa kulemba ndalama za mwezi za Rand zomwe zaonetsedwa.
fleetApply.autoDecisionDesc: Malipiro atatu afunika kuti awerengere avareji ya ndalama za sabata. Pansi pa R1000/sabata amakanidwa modzichitika. R1000/sabata kapena kuposera amasamutsa pempho ku kuwunika.
